::: {#def-rss}
#### Residual sum of squares

For a regression model whose conditional mean $\mean(x; \vth)$
depends on a parameter vector $\vth$,
the **residual sum of squares** at $\vth$
is the sum of the squared residuals
$\resid_i(\vth) \eqdef y_i - \mean(x_i; \vth)$
that the model has when its parameters equal $\vth$:

$$\text{RSS}(\vth) \eqdef \sumin \resid_i(\vth)^2.$$

At the estimate $\est{\vth}$,
$\resid_i(\est{\vth})$ is the [residual](estimation.qmd#def-residual) $\resid_i$
of the fitted model.
:::
